title: Pieverse Went From 12 Cents to $2: Here's What It Actually Is
description:
$PIEVERSE went from around 12 cents to 2 dollars in under a year. It's one of my plays, so I did the homework on exactly what it is. The short version: Pieverse lets you rent an AI agent that has its own crypto wallet, and you talk to it inside a chat app like Line or Kakao.

I go through it piece by piece. Pieverse didn't start as an AI agent project, and it has had three framings in around 12 months. I break down how Purr-Fect Claw works, with plans from 10 to 279 dollars a month and the keys locked inside secure hardware. Then what the product actually publishes about its own usage... and the one number I couldn't find.

Then the token. The run to a new all-time high, how much of the supply is circulating, and the 12-month lock on the team and investors that ends November 14th, 2026, the exact day I recorded this. Who's behind it, a 7 million dollar round led by Animoca Brands and UOB Ventures, and the three numbers I'm watching. Are you holding Pieverse or something similar?

#crypto #kaspa #pieverse #aiagents #altcoins
